title: Scalar-basis decomposition of finite-to-Qbar derived extension units
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite intermediate field E of its algebraic closure. Use the finite-subextension-valued condensed algebraic-closure coefficient ring and its pullback to every scheme Z from def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category. There exist one small indexing type I and, on the unbounded derived Omega-module category of each Z, central natural endomorphisms tau(Z,i). For every derived E-module M and every chosen I-copower of M, the map from that copower to the restriction of derived scalar extension of M, with i-th leg the extension adjunction unit followed by restriction of tau(Z,i), is invertible. For every scheme morphism f:X→Y, derived Omega-direct-image carries tau(X,i) at every M to tau(Y,i) at its image. This is an algebraic scalar compatibility statement; it asserts no preservation of infinite coproducts by direct image.

proof.text: Choose the index type and coherent coefficient sections whose actual descended scalar actions give the derived unit decomposition.

Use the explicitly proved direct-image compatibility for those coherent sections, with no direct-image preservation of infinite coproducts. Package their descended central actions and the unit decomposition in the required existential.
